title: GTA6 Evacuation Zone: PS5 and PS Plus Games This Week
description: As we approach the GTA6 release window, new game releases are dipping. Check out the notable PS5 and PS Plus games launching this week.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Approaching the GTA6 Evacuation Zone: This Week's PS5 & PS Plus Lineup

As the gaming industry fast approaches the upcoming GTA6 evacuation zone, industry observers and media outlets like Push Square note that the volume of new game releases is expected to dip dramatically throughout November. Major publishers and developers are naturally looking to clear the stage, giving the industry's biggest upcoming blockbuster plenty of breathing room.

Despite this overarching industry trend, there are still notable titles launching between November 2nd and 8th for PlayStation gamers, bringing over 28 new experiences to the PS5 and PS Plus ecosystems.

## Highlights of the Week

Among the lineup making their way to platforms this week, a few standout titles are capturing the attention of the community:

* **Zero Parades (PS5 Version)**: Bringing its experience to Sony's current-generation hardware, the PS5 version of Zero Parades is one of the premier highlights for console players this week.
* **CRYMELIGHT**: For fans of unique themes and challenging gameplay, this Alice in Wonderland-inspired roguelite offers a distinct flavor that stands out in the current release window.
* **Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters!**: Rounding out some of the familiar franchises making appearances during this period.

## Editor's Take

While the looming presence of GTA6 is already causing a slowdown in November's release schedule, it presents a golden opportunity for gamers to dive into creative indie gems like CRYMELIGHT and catch up on backlogs before the ultimate blockbuster arrives.
